pricing_model_summary: Baseline proposal: 8x H100-equivalent reserved pool (single-region, VPC) — committed cost quoted in deck. Assumptions: average sequence length 120 tokens, mix of chat (60%) + reranking (30%) + embeddings (10%). Utilization sensitivity bands: 50% / 70% / 90%. Infra-only unit cost estimates (approx): $0.00065/token @50% util, $0.00046/token @70% util, $0.00036/token @90% util. With prefix caching + batching expected effective cost down to $0.00018-$0.00030/token. Include ops & infra buffer in ARR estimate. Proposal includes throughput headroom for 25% burst and automated fallback to lower-cost quantized variants for non-LATENCY-critical routes.
notes:
Prospect snapshot - internal-style notes and call fragments:
- Use-case: product search + reranking + chat assistant inside web/mobile storefronts. Primary metric = conversion uplift; second = latency impact on UX.
- Perf targets requested: p95 <= 150ms for small chat responses (<=128 tokens), sustained throughput ~300k tokens/min for peak shopping hours, bursts to 500k tokens/min.
- Cost modeling workshop (01/29) notes: we walked through 3 commit tiers (4, 8, 16 GPUs). Key tradeoffs: commit cost vs utilization risk. Customer prefers predictable monthly line item for cost-of-goods vs variable usage.
- Quote from Head of ML: "If latency slips we lose storefront conversions — need rock-solid SLOs and predictable spend."
- Utilization assumptions they are comfortable with: 60-75% steady-state after caching. Concern: reranking multiplier (3x token count per user query) increases token burn unpredictably. Need sticky rules for token accounting between Redwood and Orion product teams.
- Security: must integrate SSO (SAML), KMS for key wrap, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Data residency: customer data must remain in us-east-1 region.
- Pricing sensitivity: procurement asked for 6-month and 12-month committed options; finance wants payback <= 9 months vs current cloud spend.
- SLA negotiation points: p99 latency targets for 1x and multi-region fallbacks; credit table for missed SLOs; definition of "maintenance" windows and notification windows. Legal asked to see RBAC and audit log retention policy.
- Action items: engineering to provide simple token accounting template; SE to run short profiling POC on two peak storefront queries (Jira RWF-1478). Finance to provide current monthly token burn for last 3 months (requested).
- Open risks: procurement window (Q2 budget closing), possible need for private deployment if third-party data processors are involved.
